## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior or bug and link the related roadmap task or issue.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant Python tests and/or browser scenario passed
- [ ] Web assets rebuilt when `web/src/` changed
- [ ] New or changed commands were checked from a clean environment where practical
- [ ] Docs and security limits still match the code

List exact commands, OS and any unverified behavior. Do not attach credentials, private hostnames or sensitive terminal output. Send vulnerability details through the process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
